qs.q: Which of the following interventions forms a core component of Kangaroo mother care (KMC)?
qs.e: KMC consists of preterm infant care practices that include skin-to-skin contact, breastfeeding, and close post discharge follow-up. Mechanical ventilation is not a standard component of KMC.

qs.q: What is a recommended practice included as a standard component of Kangaroo mother care (KMC) for preterm infants?
qs.e: Kangaroo mother care consists of various preterm infant care practices that include skin-to-skin contact, breastfeeding, and close post-discharge follow-up. Advanced respiratory support like continuous positive airway pressure is part of general stabilization rather than the core definition of KMC.

qs.q: What is the proper positioning technique for a newborn during Kangaroo Mother Care?
o: Swaddled tightly in blankets on lap
qs.e: Kangaroo Mother Care requires skin-to-skin contact with the infant placed vertically between the mother's breasts. Swaddling the infant prevents direct skin-to-skin contact required for effective thermoregulation.
